authorization: Maintainer explicitly approved replacing the baseline because this version performs more analysis.
rationale: Preserve complete candidate traversal and the expanded region, review and navigation evidence; compare subsequent regressions against the same capability set.

accepted_previous_version_cost.interpretation: Observed total cost accepted by maintainer; not proof that every millisecond is caused by added capability, not a corpus-wide estimate or a new timing pass.

remaining_qualification: Current-product cache mutation/recovery and watch latency/resource checks
Independent native archive verification on every supported target
Full remote nightly and deep soundness
Absolute latency/resource characterization across all 120 repositories in three modes and the 17 base workloads; existing one-repository timing is not full coverage
limitations: Frozen binary is local and checksum-pinned; missing binaries fail closed, local rebuilds require a separately reviewed artifact registration.
Only aarch64-apple-darwin is registered; other targets require their own artifact registration.

Official-version cache/watch comparisons remain upgrade-cost evidence; a prior-version relative slowdown alone no longer blocks this accepted capability transition. Resource and correctness limits remain mandatory.
Generic PR merge smoke still compares its base and head; this manifest changes release performance attribution, not arbitrary CI failures.
